plan.scope: All presently recovered collision records plus new rolling measurements; distinguish actual predictions, same-data estimation, historical comparators and unavailable full-state checks.
plan.documented_parameters: Keep all published normal/tangential restitution and source sliding/rolling curves fixed. Never relabel the Cornell single sliding coefficient as independently measured static friction.

tennis_fit.parameter: One nonnegative effective constant mu_r per specimen, least squares
tennis_fit.training: Sort by apparent angular speed; use zero-based even points
tennis_fit.validation: Use zero-based odd points without tuning, plus leave-one-speed-point-out sensitivity
tennis_fit.data: Experimental blue circle centers in the three PDF page-6 plots; exclude regression curves and deduplicate repeated marker paths
tennis_fit.interpretation: Effective quasirolling coefficient in that apparatus, not a universal ball/material property or bouncing validation

ball_moment_audit.fixed: Cross 2010 Table I en, et, incidence 25 degrees, measured mass and radius; assumed homogeneous inertia alpha=0.4
ball_moment_audit.estimate: Nonnegative effective angular resistance mu_r for each pair, moment impulse -mu_r R times normal impulse; singleton calibration, no independent holdout
ball_moment_audit.rejection: A required spin-assisting couple is not admissible as dissipative rolling resistance; keep residual rather than fitting a negative mu_r
ball_moment_audit.uncertainty: Report envelope over published incidence, restitution and spin error limits; maximum-error limits are not confidence intervals
ball_moment_audit.additional_signed_moment_hypothesis: After the passive rolling audit, test a signed normal-pressure moment arm: fit one common offset/R per ball to three surfaces, predict the fourth, four folds. This can assist spin without calling a negative coefficient friction. Shared counterface transfer and actual patch size are unqualified; retain every held-out failure and passivity result.

plan.rock_policy: Recompute the previously fixed three-coefficient sphere-proxy comparator and conditional inverse moment audit. It is historical evidence, not the requested directional full-moment rock prediction; measured shape/inertia/signed angular states remain unavailable.
plan.mechanics: New isolated no-slip rolling checks in 2D and arbitrarily rotated 3D: independent angular impulse, coupled static reaction, energy, arrest, ell invariance and static-capacity rejection. No production implementation or all-case qualification claimed.

rolling_mechanics.scope: Synthetic isolated rolling controls, not empirical collision or native group validation

Negative author curve intercepts are apparent-speed/skid behavior, not a negative material friction coefficient; never extrapolate those curves.

balls.explanation: Fixed measured e_n/e_t and angle; approximate 4 m/s only sets displayed dimensional states. Spin factor is speed-independent. Scalar impulses use full incoming t; zero incoming spin uses the planar force-induced spin onset axis. These are reduced instantaneous endpoint calculations, not native trajectories. Tangential output is reconstructed from author e_t and measured S, not a separate raw-velocity validation.
balls.fit_interpretation: A fitted negative resistance would be an assisting torque and is rejected here. A real deformable patch can return elastic energy through a moment, so this rejects a purely dissipative rolling explanation, not all independent angular impulses.

rocks.status: Recomputed historical zero-free-couple sphere proxy; not a prediction of actual rock geometry or requested full-angular model
limitations: homogeneous sphere inertia rather than unavailable actual facet meshes
